Messages.Author: Serge Salazar
Messages.Body:
Blood Brother Ambush: Action Modifier, Brujah Antitribu, 2 blood
Only usable when an action is blocked. Combat does not occur. Put this card
into play. While in play, this card represents an ally with 3 life and 2
strength who can strike for 2R damage; this ally enters combat with the
blocking minion. Blood Brothers may play cards requiring basic Potence as a
vampire with a capacity of 3. Any cost in blood is paid with life. If a card
would give them blood, give them life instead. Burn this card at the end of
combat or if the combat is canceled.

Question:
VampireA, in topor, tries to leave topor and is successfully intercepted by
VampireB. Can VampireA play "Blood Brother Ambush"?

Different question:
VampireA declares a bleed action against MethuselahB. MethuselahB declares
no block against the bleed action. VampireA modifies the bleed action to
increase it. MethuselahB's VampireB, with (1) blood, plays "Forced
Awakening" and "Redirection". When does VampireB burn the blood?
Immediately? After the bleed action resolves?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Serge Salazar wrote:
> VampireA, in topor, tries to leave topor and is successfully intercepted by
> VampireB. Can VampireA play "Blood Brother Ambush"?

Yes, if vampireA is a Brujah antitribu.

> Different question:
> VampireA declares a bleed action against MethuselahB. MethuselahB declares
> no block against the bleed action. VampireA modifies the bleed action to
> increase it. MethuselahB's VampireB, with (1) blood, plays "Forced
> Awakening" and "Redirection". When does VampireB burn the blood?
> Immediately? After the bleed action resolves?

When the action resolves.
